# hetznerrobot_storageboxes (Data Source)

Lists the account's Storage Boxes, or those of one server. The list carries no settings or usage — read a single box with `hetznerrobot_storagebox` for those. Only the inclusive **BX10 (100 GB)** Storage Box of a dedicated server is still managed through Robot; every other Storage Box moved to the [Hetzner Console API](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/hetzner#storage-boxes) (the `hcloud` provider). Every Storage Box write is limited to one request per 5 seconds, which the provider waits out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The boxes of one server; leave linked_server out for the whole account.
data "hetznerrobot_storageboxes" "web" {
  linked_server = 321
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `linked_server` (Number) Number of a server; only its boxes are listed.

### Read-Only

- `storageboxes` (Attributes List) The Storage Boxes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storageboxes))

<a id="nestedatt--storageboxes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storageboxes`

Read-Only:

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the box is cancelled.
- `id` (Number) Storage Box id.
- `linked_server` (Number) Number of the server the box belongs to.
- `location` (String) Location of the box.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the box is locked.
- `login` (String) Main user name.
- `name` (String) Name of the Storage Box.
- `paid_until` (String) Paid-until date.
- `product` (String) Product, e.g. `BX10`.
